title: [GMCP 203.010.03] Integration: Complete resource server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-010-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: Static and templated resources support deterministic discovery, URI completion, text and binary reads, metadata, pagination/filtering, cache semantics, list and update notifications, modern filtered subscriptions, authorization, cancellation, and bounded streaming. URI-template matching, traversal, races, stale cache, not-found semantics, MIME handling, and large-resource behavior pass positive and adversarial fixtures. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
